description: Pass-count floors for the XSLT conformance harness (gate G3). CI fails a shard whose passed count drops more than 5 below the figure here or whose in-scope count drifts by more than 1%, and fails the combined run if passed / in-scope falls below 'minimumPassRate'. Update this file only in a dedicated commit that explains the change (engine improvement, test-suite pin bump, filter revision).
